children.text: With the arrival of June, the holiday season can officially be considered open. Every year, the geography of international travel for citizens of Georgia expands thanks to the liberalization of visa procedures and the development of digital services.However, when choosing exotic destinations, it is extremely important to review the visa requirements accurately and in advance.In today's blog, we present 5 popular summer destinations that you can travel to thanks to simplified bureaucratic procedures.

Indonesia, and Bali in particular, is one of the most sought-after destinations during the summer season. An electronic visa system is in place for entry into the country.
Applicants have two main ways to obtain it:

The application is filled out on the official Indonesian immigration portal. A mandatory requirement is proof of funds in a bank account of at least 2,000 USD. The visa fee is 65 USD. It should be noted that due to technical issues on the website, the application process often becomes complicated.
When applying through an accredited company in Indonesia, the visa is typically processed within 6–7 business days. This option helps avoid technical risks and system glitches.

If minimal bureaucracy is your priority, the Republic of Maldives is an excellent choice. A tourist visa is issued directly upon crossing the border, on arrival.The length of stay is 30 days, which is quite sufficient for a full vacation.This type of visa does not require a complex preliminary application. You will only need a valid passport and travel confirmation documents, making this destination particularly attractive for lovers of spontaneous trips.

Cuba offers travelers a simplified electronic system, making the application process as convenient as possible.
The Cuban visa is single-entry and can be used within 12 months from the issuance date.
The allowed period of stay under the visa is 90 days. If you decide to stay on the island longer, the duration of stay can be extended for another 90 days by applying to the local immigration service.
The visa procedure for entering Jamaica takes place at the point of arrival, but it has its own specific features.
Even though the visa is issued directly upon arrival, the applicant must fill out a visa application form in advance, prior to the trip, and send the necessary documents to the point of arrival.
This is a mandatory requirement that helps clear border formalities smoothly and obtain entry permission without extra complications.

Seychelles is one of the most accessible destinations for citizens of Georgia. A visa is not required for tourist trips, which significantly simplifies travel. The only mandatory condition is filling out an electronic travel authorization form in advance, which is a standard informational procedure completed online prior to departure.

When planning your trip, remember that strict adherence to visa and entry requirements will help you avoid unnecessary hassles during your vacation. Our consultant is ready to assist you with preparing all the necessary documents so that your summer journey brings only pleasant impressions.
You travel — we take care of the visa!
